mentions.name: Lacôte-style guitar build
mentions.description: A hand-built acoustic guitar project in the style of 19th-century luthier Lacôte, with design research (including a book on Vicente Arias) and wood stock preparation underway before committing to a final design.
mentions.source_excerpt: Last night I decided to take a break from the digital world and started on making a guitar. Leaning towards something in the style of Lacôte[0] but not sure, ordered a book on Vicente Arias[1] and might order a couple other plans to consider.
